entities.name: Query ASADH
observations: 345 aa soluble enzyme candidate; calculated molecular weight 37.13 kDa and pI 5.14.
Contains Semialdhyde_dh PF01118.31 at residues 5–119 and Semialdhyde_dhC PF02774.24 at residues 138–326.
Shares 58.3% identity over 98.6% query coverage with reviewed Aquifex aeolicus aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase O67716.
Shares 54.6% identity over 97.4% query coverage with reviewed Bacillus subtilis aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase Q04797.
Predicted function is aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase, EC 1.2.1.11; homology supports but does not experimentally establish exact activity.
Likely NADP(H)-dependent cytosolic homodimer based on reviewed homolog annotations; localization and oligomerization remain inferred.

entities.name: ASADH reaction
observations: Rhea RHEA:24284: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+), equivalent to the reverse-direction representation of the physiological reductive dephosphorylation reaction.
The annotated physiological direction is NADPH-dependent conversion of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: ASADH catalyzes the second step of the aspartate-family pathway leading toward lysine, methionine, homoserine, and threonine biosynthesis.
